architecture.primary_rule: Primary structure, waterproofing, egress, fire/electrical isolation and other accepted life-safety functions must remain independently safe without detachable or motorised R&D modules.
architecture.experimental_strategy: Hybrid/staged: begin from a stable common structural/service substrate; compare interchangeable geometry/topology families when information gain justifies widening the design space.
interface_rules: Wet-service anchors are selected only where justified and must be isolatable.
Motorised panels require safe state, local/manual override and failure isolation.
Moving modules must not be the sole accepted weatherproofing or life-safety layer.
Inter-panel/cornice weather closure is separately qualified from actuation.
Removal of a module leaves capped safe services and accepted circulation/weather state.
Each module and anchor assembly receives persistent Asset_ID/configuration lineage.

free_flow_terrestrial.internal_casing: separate electroplated experimental internal carrier per existing Free Flow R&D concept
free_flow_terrestrial.scale_family: bench through approximately 1 m3 Phase-1; larger tests require evidence-triggered proposal and review
free_flow_terrestrial.topology_strategy: Hybrid/staged: preserve a common testbed/interface baseline while allowing alternative geometry families to be proposed and compared when results justify them.

temporary_module_lifecycle.upgrade_rule: Higher-spec use requires new fit-out, classification, hazard review and acceptance.
